desc: 黄油淡桃棉云棚拍的双提环刻度奶瓶，八屏柔光漏斗式详情
leaf: 带双侧提环与软吸嘴的宽颈刻度奶瓶
name: 黄油棉云双提环刻度奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用奶油象牙纸场加黄油与淡桃云片剪纸、4200K 柔晨光一次交代收腰瓶身、双侧提环、螺纹宽瓶盖环与坐在环内的吸嘴，靠柔软暖调抢到首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部云片剪纸内放居中主标，云片下方奶油地上放一行居中小字副标，两角各一枚小太阳发丝标记

shots.intent: 把参考图四枚水滴图章的工艺宫格改写为四张留白云形填写板与四枚太阳发丝点，条目全部交给占位符，从根上杜撰不出材质、耐摔与功效
shots.textZone: 顶部云片内一条居中标题，四张云板各一枚太阳发丝点与一条完全空白的标签行

shots.intent: 复刻详情页左右对照版式但整只左栏留白给卖家自贴，右栏只拍本品瓶口与提环根部的闭合关系，绝不虚构对手品与胜负结论
shots.textZone: 顶部云片内一条居中对照标题，两栏各一条完全空白的标签行与一枚太阳发丝点

shots.intent: 仰视微距交代双侧提环根部、螺纹宽瓶盖环与吸嘴夹持的装配关系，用柔晨光与真实塑料折射撑起做工可信度
shots.textZone: 左下角一条完全空白的标签行与一枚太阳发丝点

shots.intent: 把本品放进柔暖晨光居家语境让买家代入，成人从肩下取景、孩子一律背影或下颌以上裁出画面且全程被托抱看护，绝不出现婴儿正脸与含乳镜头
以 90 度正侧交代收腰瓶身、外扩圆弧底与双侧提环的对称轮廓，三枚太阳发丝引线把结构条目全部交给占位符
shots.textZone: 右侧三行完全空白的标签行，顶部云片内一条居中造型小标题

shots.intent: 复刻参考图两只同款前后错落的产品并列撑起货架感，配色严格限定参考图既有的一档，选款云片标签整块留空且不暗示容量与月龄差异
shots.textZone: 两瓶下方各一枚完全空白的云形标签板，顶部云片内一条居中选款小标题

shots.intent: 在同一棉云体系里收口，把参考图末屏的空白参数表与加购引导改写成两行空白填写位与一枚空白行动板，绝不出现价格、会员角标与二维码
shots.textZone: 下部留白带放居中结束标题、一枚空白云形行动板与两条完全空白的填写行，底部一条云片小字带

style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright and fully closed at a stable scale on the shallow curved ivory paper shelf; the waisted body silhouette with its narrow waist and flared rounded base, the two symmetric curved loop handles with their ball ends and their attachment points at the collar and the lower body, the ribbed wide collar ring screwed closed, the neck ring beneath it and the single spout fully seated and clamped inside the collar are never redrawn, resized, simplified, mirrored or relocated; the reference set shows no transparent overcap, no separately visible straw, valve, vent or tube and no second spout, so none of those may be invented on any screen; only the reference colourway appears in every screen and no alternative colourway may be created or named in words; the graduation tick strip on the front face keeps its reference placement, spacing and count while every numeric reading on it stays one blank legible field with no digits and no unit; any printed motif or label on the body keeps its exact reference placement and scale while all wording inside that label area always reads as one blank legible field; the twin loop handles appear in every screen exactly as the reference shows them and are never added to another product nor removed; the product never floats, always keeps its soft contact shadow, is never occluded by props, clouds or a leader line, vertical lines stay strictly vertical, and one real paper cloud cut-out or wadding tuft stays in every scene shot to anchor scale honestly
style.surfaceSystem: matte ivory #F8F3E8 paper shelf with a rolled lip and a real paper fibre tooth, edged by cotton wadding tufts whose individual fibres read at the tip; the translucent waisted body renders as true diffusing plastic with soft internal shading and a refraction line where the wall thickens, the ribbed collar ring as moulded satin plastic with a readable step on each rib, the seated spout as real elastomer with a soft matte skin and no wet gloss; the bottle settles with visible weight so one soft oval contact shadow sits directly under the rounded base; no gloss floor, no wet surface, no droplets, no splash and no steam anywhere
style.typography: one soft medium-weight rounded Chinese sans family throughout; every headline is centred on the vertical axis and sits inside a butter #F0D98F or pale peach #F6C5A2 paper cloud cut-out so the copy reads as printed on the cloud, in cocoa #4B3A2E with generous even letter-spacing; one short centred sub-line in honey #E0A052 sits on the ivory field directly beneath the cloud; section titles repeat the same cloud-mounted centred device at a smaller size; one short line of copy only, no dense body text; never a heavy extruded 3D bubble letter or cartoon outline type, never a serif, never a handwritten face, never a Latin overprint word or wide-tracked small-caps kicker strip, never a left-flush underline rule, never a highlighter band, never a boxed headline frame, never a folded ribbon flag, never mixed fonts
